prediction_text: Direction: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election — this is the individual panel astrologer's call, distinct from the panel majority. The astrologer who, when 17 Republicans still contested, had already picked Trump to take the nomination (against the field) follows the same contrarian chart reading through to the general election: Trump beats Clinton on 8 November 2016 despite her polling lead. Timing: 8 November 2016 (day-scale, single-day ballot). Confidence tier: direction medium; the polling-lead counterweight is acknowledged in the basis, not suppressed.
basis:

systems_used: Western mundane/electional astrology (individual chart-based call; track-record weighting)

Item check: Trump win → referent chain lands on the singled-out astrologer's face; triggers = (1) demonstrated contrarian accuracy on this same cycle (nominee call against a 17-person field) is the card's only reader-specific evidence and it points at Trump; (2) a reader who took Trump at long odds for the nomination does not reverse at the general on the same charts. Fact-priority tension noted honestly: polls favour Clinton — that face is loaded and weighed, and is the reason confidence is medium, not high; it constrains the majority reading (WP-004) but this card's subject is the dissenter. Object check (f): bearer = this astrologer's forecast, applier = Trump's candidacy, identical as framed. Timing (k): day scale, card-given date; (h) routes: election date (taken), nomination-call date (track-record evidence, not coordinate), polls (counterweight, logged). 
(n) Two-route re-derivation: route 1 = track-record/contrarian-consistency → Trump; route 2 = subject-identification re-check (card's provenance singles out this reader vs the panel) → same subject, same call; routes agree, retained. Grain check: no margin or state detail stated (0 pointers).
